title: Product catalog displays correctly with images and fallback
description: Verify that the product catalog grid shows all products with images, names, descriptions, and prices. If a product image fails to load, a fallback UI is displayed instead.

steps.description: Navigate to the product catalog page
Check that all products are displayed in grid layout with name, description, and price
Verify that product images load correctly
Simulate a product image load failure
Verify that a fallback colored div UI is shown for the failed image

title: Add products to shopping cart updates cart badge and state
description: Ensure that adding products to the shopping cart updates the cart badge count in the header and maintains the cart state during the browser session.

steps.description: Navigate to product catalog page
Add a product to the shopping cart
Verify the cart badge count increments by one
Add multiple different products to cart
Verify the cart badge reflects total item count correctly
Reload the page
Verify that the cart badge and contents persist in the session

title: Update product quantity in cart and check total price recalculation
description: Validate that updating the quantity of products in the cart correctly recalculates the cart totals and updates the UI accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to cart page with products added
Increase the quantity of a product
Verify the product quantity updates in the cart
Verify cart total price updates accordingly (accounting for noted price calculation bug)
Decrease the quantity of the same product
Verify the quantity and total price update correctly

title: Remove items from cart updates totals and badge count
description: Check that removing items from the shopping cart properly updates the cart total price and cart badge count in real-time.

steps.description: Navigate to cart page with multiple products added
Remove one product from the cart
Verify the product is removed from the cart display
Verify the cart total price updates without errors
Verify the cart badge count decrements accordingly

title: Checkout form validation accepts valid inputs and rejects invalid
description: Verify that all checkout form fields validate input formats correctly, accepting valid data and rejecting invalid data according to specified patterns.

steps.description: Navigate to checkout page
Enter valid ZIP codes (e.g., 12345 and 12345-6789)
Verify ZIP code field accepts valid patterns
Enter invalid ZIP code formats (e.g., 1234, abcde)
Verify ZIP code field validation error appears
Enter valid card numbers with lengths 13 to 19 digits
Verify card number field accepts these numbers
Enter invalid card numbers (less than 13 or more than 19 digits, or containing letters)
Verify card number validation error appears
Enter valid expiry dates in MM/YY format
Verify expiry date field accepts valid formats
Enter invalid expiry formats (e.g., 13/22, MM/YYYY, letters)
Verify expiry date validation error appears
Enter valid CVV codes with 3 or 4 digits
Verify CVV field accepts valid inputs
Enter invalid CVVs (e.g., 2 digits, letters, 5 digits)
Verify CVV validation error appears

title: Complete checkout order submission and confirmation
description: Test the full checkout process flow from entering valid shipping and payment details, submitting the order, to receiving confirmation and cart clearing.

steps.description: Navigate to checkout page with items in cart
Fill in all required shipping and payment fields with valid data
Submit the order
Verify simulated order processing delay of ~2 seconds occurs
Verify order confirmation message is displayed
Verify shopping cart is cleared after order submission

title: API GET all products returns correct data and status
description: Verify the REST API endpoint to get all products responds with correct HTTP status and product list JSON data.

steps.description: Send GET request to /products API endpoint
Verify response HTTP status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains array of products with expected fields

title: API GET single product returns specific product or 404
description: Ensure that GET request for a single product by ID returns correct product data or 404 if product does not exist.

steps.description: Send GET request to /products/{valid_id} API endpoint
Verify response HTTP status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains product details matching requested ID
Send GET request to /products/{invalid_id} API endpoint
Verify response HTTP status is 404 Not Found

title: API POST create new product stores data and returns status
description: Test that posting a new product to the API successfully stores the product and returns appropriate success status and data.

steps.description: Send POST request to /products with valid new product JSON payload
Verify response HTTP status is 201 Created
Verify response body contains the created product with assigned ID
Send GET request to /products to confirm new product is listed
Verify new product appears in the product list

title: API DELETE product removes product and returns status
description: Validate that deleting a product by ID through the API removes it from storage and returns proper HTTP status codes.

steps.description: Send DELETE request to /products/{valid_id}
Verify HTTP status is 200 OK or 204 No Content
Send GET request to /products/{deleted_id}
Verify response status is 404 Not Found confirming deletion

title: API endpoints respond with appropriate error codes on invalid requests
description: Check API endpoints return appropriate HTTP error codes (400, 404, 500) for invalid input, missing resources, and server errors.

steps.description: Send POST request to /products with invalid payload (missing required fields)
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Send GET request to /products/invalid_id format
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request or 404 Not Found
Send DELETE request to /products/nonexistent_id
Verify response status is 404 Not Found

title: Navigation system updates active states and transitions smoothly
description: Verify multi-page navigation changes views between Products, Cart, and Checkout pages with active navigation indicators and cart badge visible.

steps.description: Open application and check default active page is Products
Verify active state indicator is shown on Products navigation item
Click on Cart navigation item
Verify navigation changes to Cart page
Verify Cart navigation item is highlighted as active
Click on Checkout navigation item
Verify navigation changes to Checkout page
Verify Checkout navigation item is active

title: Cart badge accurately displays total item count throughout navigation
description: Test that the cart badge in header updates correctly with added, updated, or removed items and remains consistent as user navigates between pages.

steps.description: Add 3 products to cart from product catalog
Verify cart badge shows count '3'
Navigate to Cart page
Remove one item from cart
Verify cart badge updates to '2'
Navigate to Products page
Verify cart badge still shows '2'

title: Responsive layout renders correctly across devices and browsers
description: Verify that product catalog grid and all application UI components adapt fluidly to various screen sizes, resolutions, and common browsers.

steps.description: Open application on desktop browser at various resolutions (e.g., full HD, 1280x720)
Verify grid layout adjusts properly with no content overlap or cutoff
Open application using tablet and mobile devices or emulators
Verify navigation menu, product cards, cart, and checkout forms display responsively and are fully accessible
Test application in latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge browsers
Verify no UI layout or functional inconsistencies across browsers

title: Cart total price calculation accounts for quantity with known bug verification
description: Verify total price in shopping cart calculates based on quantity times product price, noting the bug of multiplying final price by 1.1 to assess impact on displayed total.

steps.description: Add a product with known price to cart with quantity 1
Verify total price matches product price multiplied by 1.1 (reported bug)
Increase quantity to 2
Verify total price equals (price * 2) * 1.1
Remove product from cart
Verify total price updates to zero
